title: Night of the Living Dead: Live from Wisconsin - Hosted by Mark & Mike
overview: Mark Borchardt and Mike Schank, the stars of AMERICAN MOVIE, host George Romero's classic NIGHT OF THE LIVING DEAD from lawn chairs parked in a suburban front yard on the northwest side of Milwaukee.
